title: Count occupancy through tmux and swap the control-pane allowlist by transport
action: Two transport switches, both keyed by `crate::herding::transport_kind_at(main_root)` (herding.rs: Result<TransportKind, String>, fail-open Herdr on a missing config). (A) Occupancy, wave.rs: the only process spawn is `fn live_pane_ids_via_herdr() -> Option<HashSet<String>>` (anchor `rg -n "fn live_pane_ids_via_herdr" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/wave.rs` → 763) with its sole caller `let live_panes = live_pane_ids_via_herdr();` inside `pub(super) fn occupancy` (→ 851, after `main_root` is resolved at ~843). Add `fn live_pane_ids_via_tmux() -> Option<HashSet<String>>` running `tmux list-panes -a -F '#{pane_id}'` with `stdin(Stdio::null())`, one id per non-empty line, None on any trouble (spawn failure, non-zero exit) — the same fail-closed contract that routes to `Occupancy::Fallback`. Extract the pure `fn parse_tmux_pane_list(stdout: &str) -> HashSet<String>` and test it (three ids, trailing newline, empty body → empty set; names prefixed `occupancy_tmux_`). Add `fn live_pane_ids(main_root: &Path) -> Option<HashSet<String>>` that picks by `transport_kind_at(main_root)` (Err → None) and switch the caller to it. Keep `live_pane_ids_via_herdr` byte-identical. (B) Allowlist, control_loop.rs: `fn allowed_tools_for(role: Role) -> &'static str` (anchor `rg -n "fn allowed_tools_for" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/control_loop.rs` → 212) returns the byte-copied herdr strings. Change it to `allowed_tools_for(role: Role, kind: TransportKind) -> &'static str`: the Herdr arm returns the EXACT existing strings (do not retype them — keep the literals), the Tmux arm returns the same strings with `Bash(herdr:*)` replaced by `Bash(tmux:*)` and nothing else. Thread the kind from `resolve_iteration_argv(main_root, role, turn_ceiling)` (→ 288), which already holds `main_root`. Update the existing callers/tests of `allowed_tools_for` (the literals also appear in tests at ~675, 700, 747 — `rg -n "Bash(herdr:\*)" …control_loop.rs` lists every site; the test expectations for the herdr arm stay byte-identical). Tests (prefixed `allowlist_`): tmux arm for both roles contains `Bash(tmux:*)` and not `Bash(herdr:*)`; herdr arm equals the original literal.
